tree.heading: Representative
tree.text: A legal representative of a servicemember for purposes of this chapter is either of the following:

children.text: An attorney acting on the behalf of a servicemember.
An individual possessing a power of attorney.

tree.heading: Application
tree.text: Whenever the term “servicemember” is used in this chapter, such term shall be treated as including a reference to a legal representative of the servicemember.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 519 of the former Appendix to this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section applicable to any case not final before Dec. 19, 2003, see section 3 of Pub. L. 108–189, set out as a note under section 3901 of this title.
